Method of Attack: Information-stealing Trojan that steals saved credentials in web browsers, desktop messaging clients (Pidgin, Steam, Discord), FTP clients, cryptocurrency wallets, documents, and takes screenshots of active applications
Distributed via fake advertisements impersonating legitimate applications (Microsoft Store, Spotify, online document converter)
Automatic download of malicious zip files from Amazon AWS servers
Execution of downloaded executable to run malware
Attack Vector: Fake landing pages impersonating Microsoft Store, Spotify, and online document converter
Automatic download of malware zip files from Amazon AWS servers
Indicators of Compromise: Fake Microsoft Store page for 'xChess 3' online chess application
Malicious zip files containing Ficker malware
